identity.title: [v0.92][tooling][CI] Prevent unrelated workflow fanout and isolate expensive proof

values.goal: Keep required validation on the 16-core runner while preventing optional, unrelated, duplicate, and soak jobs from automatically consuming runners or budget.
values.required_outcome: One automatic PR workflow classifies changes before runner allocation, required heavy lanes use the configured 16-core runner, optional proof stays explicit, duplicate heads coalesce, and deterministic contracts prevent regression.
declared_scope: csdlc-v2 publication duplicate-PR guard surfaces if current behavior requires repair
focused CI and coverage procedure documentation
authority_boundary: Issue #234 owns CI dispatch, routing, cost-control contracts, and publication duplicate-head prevention only
Required heavy validation remains on vars.ADL_HEAVY_RUNNER with the approved 16-core value
No GitHub organization runner, billing, or hosted-runner configuration changes are authorized
No Runtime, Guardian, Observatory, provider, demo, or product behavior changes are authorized
operator_constraints: Never write tracked implementation changes on main
Use the bound FastWork issue worktree
Do not run optional GitHub workflows while developing this policy
Validate locally, obtain bounded review, and publish one reviewed revision
Do not downgrade required heavy jobs to standard runners
